title: research-pod needs papyrus CLI on PATH for references register
description: Researcher and Papyrus desks on /workspace/research-pod still accept non-paper refs with python3 /workspace/research-pod/bin/register-ref.py onto WIKI-650fd9. papyrus is not on PATH. papyrus references register does not exist for them. Do not invent a second kbs wiki accept. Operator CLI is the accept path (same subcommands for local-pod and cloud). Install or expose papyrus on the research-pod PATH so both desks can drop the sidecar. Specs first if the register command is incomplete.
